column1: 2.2.6.3 LVPS-1. The Low Voltage Power Supply-1 is rugged in construction and designed to
comply for MIL-810F (as applicable) Environmental Standards, and MIL-461E/F (as applicable)
EMI/EMC Standards. All the components used are MIL-Grade only and will be capable to withstand
the temperature variations and humidity. The LVPS-1 caters for DC power supply requirements of
all components of BB & NB Receiver AHU.
